_comment: The squadron's comm card (decisions R3-53, H31, H84). SQUAD-WIDE data, not per Facility. Read once at startup, never written by code (P5); a copy in state/comm-card.json overrides it key by key (unknown keys stop start-up). approachTypes: the approach kinds a carrier flight's `approachType` may name, upper case; [SOURCE-DEFINED] (L4 briefing Q7), the squadron verifies the list. approachButtons: `min`/`max` are the integer range a button may take while `buttons` is empty (1..20 is DCS's radio preset range, [SOURCE-DEFINED]). Once the squadron fills `buttons` with { "button": <integer within min..max>, "label": <what it is, e.g. "CVN-72 approach"> } entries, a flight's approachButton must be one of those `button` values and nothing else. A button, never a frequency (guide 9.12 rule 6). frequencies: [{ "id": <unique string>, "name": <string>, "mhz": <number>, "use": "approach"|"tower"|"ground"|"departure"|"atis"|"other" }]. Empty and without a consumer yet: the human supplies it later (R3-53).
